The Strong Survive#001.src: I am disappointed in you Perin.
The Strong Survive#001.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#002.src: When I meet new recruits, I expect them to look at least somewhat in shape!
The Strong Survive#002.dst: Cuando conozco a un recluta nuevo, ¡espero que al menos esté algo en forma!
The Strong Survive#002.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#003.src: Yet here we are... Have you even done any training since we sent you the letter?
The Strong Survive#003.dst: Y mírate... ¿Has entrenado algo desde que te enviamos la carta?
The Strong Survive#003.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#004.src: I have been training! I swear!
The Strong Survive#004.speaker: Perin

The Strong Survive#005.src: Oh really, has a mentor been preparing you? Surely your family could afford one.
The Strong Survive#005.dst: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Te ha preparado un mentor? Seguro que tu familia puede pagar uno.
The Strong Survive#005.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#006.src: Mentor? Y-yeah, of course I have one!
The Strong Survive#006.speaker: Perin

The Strong Survive#007.src: They're right there! We were just about to start my training for the day actually.
The Strong Survive#007.dst: ¡Está ahí mismo! De hecho, íbamos a empezar mi entrenamiento de hoy.
The Strong Survive#007.speaker: Perin

The Strong Survive#009.src: So you're Perin's mentor huh? There's no other way to say this, but you must be terrible at your job...
The Strong Survive#009.dst: ¿Así que tú eres el mentor de Perin? No hay otra forma de decirlo: haces fatal tu trabajo...
The Strong Survive#009.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#010.src: You certainly look fit to be a soldier though. Perhaps training isn't your strong suit.
The Strong Survive#010.dst: Aunque desde luego tienes tipo de soldado. Quizá enseñar no sea lo tuyo.
The Strong Survive#010.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#011.src: So how about I take you to join the Fruman military instead of Perin?
The Strong Survive#011.dst: ¿Y si te llevo a ti al ejército de Fruma en vez de a Perin?
The Strong Survive#011.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#012.src: That sounds great! Meet us near the south {p} entrance, then we will take you to {p}.
The Strong Survive#012.dst: ¡Suena genial! Reúnete con nosotros en la entrada sur de {p} y te llevaremos a {p}.
The Strong Survive#012.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#013.src: Oh, and don't keep us waiting. Or it might end up on your record.
The Strong Survive#013.dst: Ah, y no nos hagas esperar. O podría constar en tu expediente.
The Strong Survive#013.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#014.src: I hope you enjoy MY spot at Tericen!
The Strong Survive#014.dst: ¡Que disfrutes de MI plaza en Tericen!
The Strong Survive#014.speaker: Perin

The Strong Survive#016.src: Meet the recruiter near the south entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Strong Survive#016.dst: Reúnete con el reclutador cerca de la entrada sur de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Strong Survive#017.src: There you are! Didn't I tell you not to keep us waiting?
The Strong Survive#017.dst: ¡Ahí estás! ¿No te dije que no nos hicieras esperar?
The Strong Survive#017.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#018.src: Get into the carriage, we'll take you to {p}.
The Strong Survive#018.dst: Sube al carruaje, te llevaremos a {p}.
The Strong Survive#018.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#019.src: You don't want to miss the opening speech from the famed Sovereign Majin!
The Strong Survive#019.dst: ¡No querrás perderte el discurso de apertura del famoso Soberano Majin!
The Strong Survive#019.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#020.src: Watch out for the horses, they can be a bit nippy.
The Strong Survive#020.dst: Cuidado con los caballos, a veces muerden.
The Strong Survive#020.speaker: Carriage Driver

The Strong Survive#022.src: Head into the carriage and then we'll go to {p}.
The Strong Survive#022.dst: Sube al carruaje y saldremos hacia {p}.
The Strong Survive#022.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#023.src: The carriage is ready to go, we're just waiting on you.
The Strong Survive#023.dst: El carruaje está listo, solo faltas tú.
The Strong Survive#023.speaker: Carriage Driver

The Strong Survive#024.src: Don't keep us waiting, get into the carriage.
The Strong Survive#024.dst: No nos hagas esperar, sube al carruaje.
The Strong Survive#024.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#025.src: You shouldn't worry about Perin anymore. Trust me, I am doing him a favour by taking you instead.
The Strong Survive#025.dst: Ya no tienes que preocuparte por Perin. Créeme, le hago un favor llevándote a ti.
The Strong Survive#025.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#026.src: Although, he will surely be shamed by his community for not becoming a soldier, but frankly, he deserves it.
The Strong Survive#026.dst: Eso sí, su pueblo lo avergonzará por no ser soldado, pero, francamente, se lo merece.
The Strong Survive#026.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#027.src: You must be very excited to become a recruit, I can see it on your face!
The Strong Survive#027.dst: ¡Se te nota en la cara lo emocionado que estás por ser recluta!
The Strong Survive#027.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#028.src: But let me warn you, the process is not all sunshine and rainbows.
The Strong Survive#028.dst: Pero te aviso: el proceso no es todo de color de rosa.
The Strong Survive#028.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#029.src: The training is grueling and competitive, every single facet of your physical ability will be tested!
The Strong Survive#029.dst: El entrenamiento es durísimo y competitivo, ¡pondrán a prueba cada faceta de tu físico!
The Strong Survive#029.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#030.src: Think you're up for it? Well, I think you could manage. You'd certainly do better than Perin!
The Strong Survive#030.dst: ¿Crees que puedes con ello? Yo diría que sí. ¡Desde luego lo harás mejor que Perin!
The Strong Survive#030.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#031.src: {p} is run by the esteemed Commander Ferreo. When you meet him, it's very important that you show him his due respect.
The Strong Survive#031.dst: {p} está al mando del honorable comandante Ferreo. Cuando lo conozcas, es muy importante que le muestres el respeto debido.
The Strong Survive#031.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#032.src: The Commander's been serving since as long as I can remember. He's probably the most accomplished man in the {p}, aside from Sovereign Majin of course!
The Strong Survive#032.dst: El comandante lleva sirviendo desde que tengo memoria. Seguramente sea el hombre más laureado de {p}, ¡aparte del Soberano Majin, claro!
The Strong Survive#032.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#033.src: Ah, I hope you're ready, we should be arriving soon.
The Strong Survive#033.dst: Ah, espero que estés listo, deberíamos llegar pronto.
The Strong Survive#033.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#035.src: We're here, just head on in and I'll meet you up ahead inside!
The Strong Survive#035.dst: ¡Ya hemos llegado! Pasa, te veo dentro más adelante.
The Strong Survive#035.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#036.src: I don't mind, but did we really need to take the carriage?
The Strong Survive#036.dst: A mí me da igual, pero ¿de verdad hacía falta el carruaje?
The Strong Survive#036.speaker: Carriage Driver

The Strong Survive#037.src: Thank the Queen, I won't have to follow this idiot around anymore, now that the recruiting process is done.
The Strong Survive#037.dst: Gracias a la Reina, ya no tendré que seguir a este idiota a todas partes, se acabó el reclutamiento.
The Strong Survive#037.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#039.src: Return to the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Strong Survive#039.dst: Vuelve a la entrada de Tericen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Strong Survive#040.src: Talk to the Uniform Tailor, then go see Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#040.dst: Habla con el sastre de uniformes y luego ve a ver al comandante Ferreo.

The Strong Survive#042.src: This is where you will be staying until you become a soldier.
The Strong Survive#042.dst: Aquí te alojarás hasta que seas soldado.
The Strong Survive#042.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#043.src: Please see the tailor across from me to get your uniform, then see Commander Ferreo in the next room.
The Strong Survive#043.dst: Recoge tu uniforme con el sastre de enfrente y luego ve a ver al comandante Ferreo en la sala de al lado.
The Strong Survive#043.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#044.src: I can't let you enter until you get your uniform, speak with the tailor.
The Strong Survive#044.dst: No puedo dejarte pasar sin uniforme, habla con el sastre.
The Strong Survive#044.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#045.src: Are you also here as a recruit?
The Strong Survive#045.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#046.src: I'm Arnol, it seems like we've made it just in time!
The Strong Survive#046.dst: Soy Arnol. ¡Parece que hemos llegado justo a tiempo!
The Strong Survive#046.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#047.src: I'll let you get your uniform. We should talk after the speech.
The Strong Survive#047.dst: Te dejo recoger tu uniforme. Hablamos tras el discurso.
The Strong Survive#047.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#048.src: Welcome to {p}! Congratulations on getting accepted to become a soldier!
The Strong Survive#048.dst: ¡Bienvenido a {p}! ¡Enhorabuena por ser aceptado como soldado!
The Strong Survive#048.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#049.src: You must be from the {p}. The rest of the recruits have already gotten their uniforms.
The Strong Survive#049.dst: Debes de ser de {p}. El resto de reclutas ya tiene su uniforme.
The Strong Survive#049.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#050.src: Your uniform colour will be yellow.
The Strong Survive#050.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#051.src: What is your name? I need to write it on your uniform.
The Strong Survive#051.dst: ¿Cómo te llamas? Tengo que bordarlo en tu uniforme.
The Strong Survive#051.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#057.src: Very funny... Now tell me what your real name is.
The Strong Survive#057.dst: Muy gracioso... Ahora dime tu nombre real.
The Strong Survive#057.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#058.src: Alright, this will only take a second or two.
The Strong Survive#058.dst: Bien, esto solo tardará un segundo o dos.
The Strong Survive#058.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#059.src: All done, here is your uniform recruit!
The Strong Survive#059.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#060.src: Now go see Commander Ferreo, he is waiting for you in the next room.
The Strong Survive#060.dst: Ahora ve a ver al comandante Ferreo, te espera en la sala de al lado.
The Strong Survive#060.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#061.src: Go see Commander Ferreo, he's in the next room.
The Strong Survive#061.dst: Ve a ver al comandante Ferreo, está en la sala de al lado.
The Strong Survive#061.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#062.src: I see you've been given your uniform. It looks good on you!
The Strong Survive#062.dst: Veo que ya te han dado el uniforme. ¡Te queda bien!
The Strong Survive#062.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#064.src: Commander Ferreo is waiting for you in the next room.
The Strong Survive#064.dst: El comandante Ferreo te espera en la sala de al lado.
The Strong Survive#064.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#065.src: Once you are done speaking with him, you'll be hearing a speech from Sovereign Majin in the stage room!
The Strong Survive#065.dst: Cuando termines de hablar con él, ¡escucharás un discurso del Soberano Majin en la sala del escenario!
The Strong Survive#065.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#066.src: Recruits are separated by their divisions, their uniform colours reflect this.
The Strong Survive#066.dst: Los reclutas se separan por divisiones, y el color del uniforme lo indica.
The Strong Survive#066.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#067.src: Those with red uniforms are from Auburn, cyan uniforms are from the Industrial district, white uniforms are in the Wings division...
The Strong Survive#067.dst: Los de uniforme rojo son de Auburn, los cian del distrito Industrial, los blancos son de la división de las Alas...
The Strong Survive#067.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#068.src: Green uniforms are in the {p} division, they are recruits selected from other regions based on a test that decides if they are suited for the dangerous conditions in the {p}...
The Strong Survive#068.dst: Los uniformes verdes son de la división de {p}: reclutas elegidos en otras regiones mediante una prueba que decide si sirven para las duras condiciones de {p}...
The Strong Survive#068.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#069.src: Since you are in the {p} division, your group leader is Recruiter Effal.
The Strong Survive#069.dst: Como estás en la división de {p}, tu jefe de grupo es el reclutador Effal.
The Strong Survive#069.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#070.src: {p} is the largest and most prestigious military training camp in Fruma, headed by the equally prestigious Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#070.dst: {p} es el campo de entrenamiento militar más grande y prestigioso de Fruma, dirigido por el no menos prestigioso comandante Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#070.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#071.src: Many of the most famous soldiers of Fruma have originated from here, you should be proud to be a part of our program!
The Strong Survive#071.dst: De aquí han salido muchos de los soldados más famosos de Fruma, ¡debes estar orgulloso de formar parte de nuestro programa!
The Strong Survive#071.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#072.src: Most recruits already know this before coming to {p}... I suppose there is no shame in asking if you don't know.
The Strong Survive#072.dst: La mayoría ya lo sabe antes de venir a {p}... Supongo que no es vergonzoso preguntar si no lo sabes.
The Strong Survive#072.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#073.src: The Fruman military is composed of nine divisions, being seven regional divisions, the Constable division, and the Wings division.
The Strong Survive#073.dst: El ejército de Fruma se compone de nueve divisiones: siete regionales, la de alguaciles y la de las Alas.
The Strong Survive#073.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#074.src: Yes, you heard that right, seven regional divisions not six. The seventh being the Xima division which recruits soldiers directly from the Auburn division, which is why most people lump them together.
The Strong Survive#074.dst: Sí, has oído bien, siete divisiones regionales, no seis. La séptima es la división Xima, que recluta soldados directamente de la de Auburn, por eso casi todos las juntan.
The Strong Survive#074.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#075.src: The Constable division has an authority level higher than all the regional divisions, and the Wings division has authority over both of them. Be careful not to step on their toes when you become a soldier!
The Strong Survive#075.dst: La división de alguaciles tiene más autoridad que todas las regionales, y la de las Alas está por encima de ambas. ¡Cuando seas soldado, ten cuidado de no pisarles el terreno!
The Strong Survive#075.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#076.src: Within each division is a ranking system used to separate leadership roles. In ascending order of authority; there are soldiers, captains, commanders, and finally a single general that manages the commanders.
The Strong Survive#076.dst: Dentro de cada división hay un sistema de rangos que marca los puestos de mando. De menor a mayor autoridad: soldados, capitanes, comandantes y, por último, un único general que dirige a los comandantes.
The Strong Survive#076.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#077.src: The Wings division has some additional positions within it, like the Gendarmes. They're a group of Wings soldiers that only operate within Aelumia.
The Strong Survive#077.dst: La división de las Alas tiene puestos adicionales, como los gendarmes. Son soldados de las Alas que solo actúan dentro de Aelumia.
The Strong Survive#077.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#078.src: Don't worry, this question is more common than you'd think.
The Strong Survive#078.dst: Tranquilo, esta pregunta es más común de lo que crees.
The Strong Survive#078.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#079.src: In about a month, if everything goes to plan, you and the rest of the recruits will attend a ceremony and officially become Fruman soldiers!
The Strong Survive#079.dst: Dentro de un mes, si todo sale según el plan, tú y el resto de reclutas asistiréis a una ceremonia y seréis soldados de Fruma oficialmente.
The Strong Survive#079.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#080.src: From there, you'll work in a group with other {p} soldiers. If you are able to impress your superiors, you can be promoted to captain or even commander!
The Strong Survive#080.dst: A partir de ahí trabajarás en grupo con otros soldados de {p}. ¡Si impresionas a tus superiores, puedes ascender a capitán o incluso a comandante!
The Strong Survive#080.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#081.src: Another thing that can happen if you demonstrate exception abilities is promotion to the Constable division or maybe even the Wings division!
The Strong Survive#081.dst: Otra cosa que puede pasar si demuestras aptitudes excepcionales es un ascenso a la división de alguaciles, ¡o incluso a la de las Alas!
The Strong Survive#081.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#082.src: There truly is fame and glory waiting ahead of you. If you are able to prove yourself.
The Strong Survive#082.dst: De verdad que te esperan fama y gloria. Si eres capaz de demostrar tu valía.
The Strong Survive#082.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#083.src: Alright, good luck on your training!
The Strong Survive#083.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#084.src: Speak with the secretary if you're lost.
The Strong Survive#084.dst: Si te pierdes, habla con el secretario.
The Strong Survive#084.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#085.src: You may not enter yet, talk to the commander and then enter the stage room across from us.
The Strong Survive#085.dst: Todavía no puedes entrar; habla con el comandante y luego pasa a la sala del escenario de enfrente.
The Strong Survive#085.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#086.src: You may not enter yet, talk to Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#086.dst: Todavía no puedes entrar, habla con el comandante Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#086.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#087.src: I can't let you enter until you talk to Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#087.dst: No puedo dejarte pasar hasta que hables con el comandante Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#087.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#088.src: You have you brought me Effal, this is not Perin.
The Strong Survive#088.dst: ¿A quién me has traído, Effal? Este no es Perin.
The Strong Survive#088.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#089.src: You will have to excuse me Commander, but I did not deem Perin as fit to be a recruit.
The Strong Survive#089.dst: Discúlpeme, comandante, pero no consideré a Perin apto para ser recluta.
The Strong Survive#089.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#090.src: The boy had done no training, he would not have lasted a day here!
The Strong Survive#090.dst: ¡El chico no había entrenado nada, no habría durado ni un día aquí!
The Strong Survive#090.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#091.src: I told him this myself, and while I was reprimanding him... Erm...
The Strong Survive#091.dst: Se lo dije yo mismo, y mientras lo reprendía... Ejem...
The Strong Survive#091.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#092.src: ... Had overheard our conversation and begged that I take them instead.
The Strong Survive#092.dst: ... oyó nuestra conversación y suplicó que lo llevara en su lugar.
The Strong Survive#092.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#093.src: Seeing that they looked more suitable than Perin, and hearing their reasoning as to why they should be a recruit, I decided to adhere to their request.
The Strong Survive#093.dst: Al ver que parecía más apto que Perin, y tras oír sus razones para ser recluta, decidí acceder a su petición.
The Strong Survive#093.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#094.src: So you deliberately acted against the directions given to you?
The Strong Survive#094.dst: ¿Así que actuaste deliberadamente contra las órdenes recibidas?
The Strong Survive#094.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#095.src: Well... Yes... I-I truly apologize for violating the orders given to me...
The Strong Survive#095.dst: Bueno... Sí... P-pido perdón sinceramente por violar las órdenes...
The Strong Survive#095.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#096.src: Do not go against what you are told to do again.
The Strong Survive#096.dst: No vuelvas a desobedecer lo que se te ordena.
The Strong Survive#096.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#097.src: Nevertheless, if what you say about Perin is true, perhaps it is for the best that he does not become a recruit.
The Strong Survive#097.dst: Aun así, si lo que dices de Perin es cierto, quizá sea mejor que no llegue a recluta.
The Strong Survive#097.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#098.src: Welcome to {p}, recruit. Enter the room to the right so that we may begin the opening speech.
The Strong Survive#098.dst: Bienvenido a {p}, recluta. Entra en la sala de la derecha para que empiece el discurso de apertura.
The Strong Survive#098.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#099.src: Thank you Commander! Now, let me lead you to the stage!
The Strong Survive#099.dst: ¡Gracias, comandante! ¡Ahora deja que te lleve al escenario!
The Strong Survive#099.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#100.src: Listen to the speech from Sovereign Majin.
The Strong Survive#100.dst: Escucha el discurso del Soberano Majin.

The Strong Survive#101.src: Shouldn't you be listening to a speech right now?
The Strong Survive#101.dst: ¿No deberías estar escuchando un discurso ahora mismo?
The Strong Survive#101.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#102.src: You may not enter yet, enter the stage room across from us.
The Strong Survive#102.dst: Todavía no puedes entrar, pasa a la sala del escenario de enfrente.
The Strong Survive#102.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#103.src: You may only enter after Sovereign Majin's speech.
The Strong Survive#103.dst: Solo puedes entrar tras el discurso del Soberano Majin.
The Strong Survive#103.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#104.src: There's no time for chit-chat, the speech is about to start!
The Strong Survive#104.dst: No hay tiempo de charlas, ¡el discurso va a empezar!
The Strong Survive#104.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#105.src: Welcome recruits, to the start of your training in becoming a Fruman soldier.
The Strong Survive#105.dst: Bienvenidos, reclutas. Empieza vuestra formación como soldados de Fruma.
The Strong Survive#105.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#106.src: You have all been carefully chosen by a group of experienced recruiters.
The Strong Survive#106.dst: A todos os han elegido con cuidado unos reclutadores expertos.
The Strong Survive#106.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#107.src: They have closely reviewed your performances in physical tests of strength and agility since you were children, and have decided that you belong here.
The Strong Survive#107.dst: Han seguido de cerca vuestros resultados en pruebas de fuerza y agilidad desde que erais niños, y han decidido que vuestro sitio está aquí.
The Strong Survive#107.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#108.src: Do not prove to me that they were wrong.
The Strong Survive#108.dst: No me demostréis que se equivocaron.
The Strong Survive#108.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#109.src: Use the opportunities given to you to show us that you deserve to be amongst your superiors.
The Strong Survive#109.dst: Aprovechad las oportunidades que se os dan para demostrarnos que merecéis estar entre vuestros superiores.
The Strong Survive#109.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#110.src: Your instructors will expect the best from you, so you must show them the best. Those who refuse or are unable to do this have no place here.
The Strong Survive#110.dst: Vuestros instructores esperarán lo mejor de vosotros, así que dádselo. Quien se niegue o no pueda, no tiene sitio aquí.
The Strong Survive#110.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#111.src: Your role will be the most important in Fruma. Ensuring the safety of the population is no small task, trust me.
The Strong Survive#111.dst: Vuestro papel será el más importante de Fruma. Garantizar la seguridad del pueblo no es poca cosa, creedme.
The Strong Survive#111.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#112.src: So, like I have, each of you must prove yourself worthy of being called a soldier of Fruma.
The Strong Survive#112.dst: Así pues, como hice yo, cada uno de vosotros debe demostrar que merece llamarse soldado de Fruma.
The Strong Survive#112.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#113.src: Let my words serve as motivation for you during your training.
The Strong Survive#113.dst: Que mis palabras os sirvan de motivación durante el entrenamiento.
The Strong Survive#113.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#114.src: We are thankful to Sovereign Majin for taking time out of his responsibilities to deliver the opening speech.
The Strong Survive#114.dst: Agradecemos al Soberano Majin que haya sacado tiempo de sus obligaciones para dar el discurso de apertura.
The Strong Survive#114.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#115.src: Now we will be bringing you to your first training session of the day, I hope you all are ready.
The Strong Survive#115.dst: Ahora os llevaremos a vuestra primera sesión de entrenamiento del día, espero que estéis listos.
The Strong Survive#115.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#116.src: Each of you will be separated into groups depending on your division. For each challenge, your group will be paired with another group.
The Strong Survive#116.dst: Se os dividirá en grupos según vuestra división. En cada desafío, vuestro grupo se emparejará con otro.
The Strong Survive#116.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#117.src: The leaders of each region grouping will be the recruiter who originally sent you the invitation letter.
The Strong Survive#117.dst: Los jefes de cada grupo regional serán los reclutadores que os enviaron la carta de invitación.
The Strong Survive#117.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#118.src: They will be the ones leading you to where you're supposed to be for the first couple of days here, following an assigned schedule.
The Strong Survive#118.dst: Ellos os llevarán a donde debáis estar durante los primeros días, siguiendo un horario asignado.
The Strong Survive#118.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#119.src: You are expected to be at your designated area, on time and ready.
The Strong Survive#119.dst: Debéis estar en la zona asignada, a tiempo y preparados.
The Strong Survive#119.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#120.src: However, if for whatever reason you get lost, go to the secretary at the main lobby desk and she will tell you where to go.
The Strong Survive#120.dst: Si por lo que sea os perdéis, id al mostrador del vestíbulo principal y la secretaria os dirá adónde ir.
The Strong Survive#120.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#121.src: Now, go convene with your recruiters in the main room to your left, then they will take you to your first training session.
The Strong Survive#121.dst: Ahora, reuníos con vuestros reclutadores en la sala principal de la izquierda, y ellos os llevarán a la primera sesión.
The Strong Survive#121.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#122.src: That was a pretty good speech, I was a bit nervous, but now I am ready to start the training!
The Strong Survive#122.dst: Ha sido un discurso muy bueno. Estaba algo nervioso, ¡pero ya estoy listo para empezar!
The Strong Survive#122.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#123.src: I'm Arnol, I come from the nobel {p} Tasa family, Fruma has done so much for us, so I am ready to help her.
The Strong Survive#123.dst: Soy Arnol, de la noble familia Tasa de {p}. Fruma ha hecho mucho por nosotros, y estoy listo para ayudarla.
The Strong Survive#123.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#124.src: I'm glad that you're from the {p}. That means we're in the same group!
The Strong Survive#124.dst: Me alegra que seas de {p}. ¡Eso significa que vamos en el mismo grupo!
The Strong Survive#124.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#125.src: How about you and I stick together during our training?
The Strong Survive#125.dst: ¿Qué te parece si tú y yo nos apoyamos durante el entrenamiento?
The Strong Survive#125.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#126.src: My family tells me that recruits often end up very... competitive...
The Strong Survive#126.dst: Mi familia dice que los reclutas acaban siendo muy... competitivos...
The Strong Survive#126.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#127.src: So I think we can both benefit from sticking together, and watching each others' backs.
The Strong Survive#127.dst: Así que creo que a los dos nos conviene ir juntos y cubrirnos las espaldas.
The Strong Survive#127.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#128.src: Anyways, we should head to our group's leader, I think his name is Effal?
The Strong Survive#128.dst: En fin, deberíamos ir con el jefe de nuestro grupo, ¿se llama Effal?
The Strong Survive#128.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#129.src: Talk to Recruiter Effal then head to the challenge room at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#129.dst: Habla con el reclutador Effal y luego ve a la sala de desafíos en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#130.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#130.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#131.src: After corresponding with you recruiter, head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room then go down the stairs on the right.
The Strong Survive#131.dst: Tras reunirte con tu reclutador, entra en la sala siguiente, cruza a la puerta de enfrente y baja las escaleras de la derecha.
The Strong Survive#131.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#132.src: From there, head into the challenge room your team leader told you about.
The Strong Survive#132.dst: Desde ahí, entra en la sala de desafíos que te dijo tu jefe de grupo.
The Strong Survive#132.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#133.src: Good luck on your first challenge, I believe in you!
The Strong Survive#133.dst: ¡Suerte en tu primer desafío, confío en ti!
The Strong Survive#133.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#134.src: Good luck with your training, recruit. But I'll warn you, Commander Ferreo is no pushover.
The Strong Survive#134.dst: Suerte con el entrenamiento, recluta. Pero te aviso: al comandante Ferreo no se le engaña.
The Strong Survive#134.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#135.src: Do you need help with something recruit? Your team leader is Recruiter Effal, go see him for instructions.
The Strong Survive#135.dst: ¿Necesitas ayuda, recluta? Tu jefe de grupo es el reclutador Effal, ve a él para las instrucciones.
The Strong Survive#135.speaker: Recruiter Alena

The Strong Survive#136.src: You know it's not too late to turn back. You risk losing more than just your pride here.
The Strong Survive#136.dst: Sabes que aún estás a tiempo de dar la vuelta. Aquí te arriesgas a perder algo más que el orgullo.
The Strong Survive#136.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#137.src: Definitely not going to happen. After hearing that speech from Sovereign Majin, I feel like I could take on the entire resistance!
The Strong Survive#137.dst: Ni hablar. ¡Después de oír ese discurso del Soberano Majin, siento que podría con toda la resistencia yo sola!
The Strong Survive#137.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#138.src: Are you nervous like me? We're about to start the training and I still don't feel ready.
The Strong Survive#138.dst: ¿Estás nervioso como yo? El entrenamiento va a empezar y aún no me siento preparado.
The Strong Survive#138.speaker: Verdi

The Strong Survive#139.src: I shouldn't worry, if anything goes wrong, I know Recruiter Alena will be there to help.
The Strong Survive#139.dst: No debería preocuparme; si algo sale mal, sé que la reclutadora Alena estará ahí para ayudar.
The Strong Survive#139.speaker: Verdi

The Strong Survive#140.src: But at the same time, It's hard not to be scared...
The Strong Survive#140.dst: Pero, aun así, cuesta no tener miedo...
The Strong Survive#140.speaker: Verdi

The Strong Survive#142.src: Ugh... How did Arnol end up here?...
The Strong Survive#142.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#143.src: That speech from Sovereign Majin was amazing...
The Strong Survive#143.dst: El discurso del Soberano Majin fue increíble...
The Strong Survive#143.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#144.src: I was almost brought to tears... I wish with all my heart that I may serve under him one day!
The Strong Survive#144.dst: Casi me hace llorar... ¡Deseo con todo mi corazón servir algún día a sus órdenes!
The Strong Survive#144.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#145.src: Sorry, but I'm not your team leader, since your in the {p} group, your team leader is uhmm... Ah, it's Recruiter Effal.
The Strong Survive#145.dst: Lo siento, no soy tu jefe de grupo; como estás en el grupo de {p}, tu jefe es... ehmm... Ah, el reclutador Effal.
The Strong Survive#145.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#146.src: I'm so glad to finally be out of the Roughworks. Although, after the training, we will have to go back...
The Strong Survive#146.dst: Qué alegría salir por fin de Roughworks. Aunque, tras el entrenamiento, tendremos que volver...
The Strong Survive#146.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#147.src: I figured you'd be used to it after spending your whole life living there.
The Strong Survive#147.dst: Pensaba que ya estarías acostumbrado, con toda una vida viviendo allí.
The Strong Survive#147.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#148.src: I think Holger is just impressed by the luxuries of the {p}. I'd imagine even the slums here are fancier than the Roughworks.
The Strong Survive#148.dst: Creo que a Holger solo le impresionan los lujos de {p}. Me imagino que hasta los barrios bajos de aquí son más finos que Roughworks.
The Strong Survive#148.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#149.src: Excuse me, Ezero sir, is it true the soldiers around here call Commander Ferreo 'The Iron Commander'?
The Strong Survive#149.dst: Disculpe, señor Ezero, ¿es cierto que los soldados de aquí llaman al comandante Ferreo "el Comandante de Hierro"?
The Strong Survive#149.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#150.src: I believe he used to go by that nickname in his younger years, he was quite the fearsome leader.
The Strong Survive#150.dst: Creo que de joven lo llamaban así, sí; era un líder bastante temible.
The Strong Survive#150.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#151.src: You should be careful not to get on his bad side... The last guy that did got exiled to Wynn...
The Strong Survive#151.dst: Ten cuidado de no caerle mal... Al último que lo hizo lo desterraron a Wynn...
The Strong Survive#151.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#153.src: Heh, I'm just messing with oyu kid, you don't have to worry about him, he's softened up a lot over the years.
The Strong Survive#153.dst: Je, te estoy tomando el pelo, chaval. No tienes que temerle, se ha ablandado mucho con los años.
The Strong Survive#153.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#154.src: I am not your team leader. Go find Recruiter Effal, the person wearing the same coloured clothes as you.
The Strong Survive#154.dst: No soy tu jefe de grupo. Busca al reclutador Effal, el que lleva la ropa del mismo color que tú.
The Strong Survive#154.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#155.src: Shouldn't be too hard to do, I'd think.
The Strong Survive#155.dst: No creo que sea muy difícil.
The Strong Survive#155.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#156.src: Alright, time to put these skills to use! Are you ready for this, Katze?
The Strong Survive#156.dst: ¡Muy bien, hora de poner esto en práctica! ¿Te ves con ello, Katze?
The Strong Survive#156.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#157.src: I'm ready! Let's show everyone we're the best!
The Strong Survive#157.dst: ¡Vamos allá! ¡Demostremos a todos que somos los mejores!
The Strong Survive#157.speaker: Katze

The Strong Survive#158.src: Are you from the {p}? I recognize everyone in that group except you, strange...
The Strong Survive#158.dst: ¿Eres de {p}? Conozco a todos los de ese grupo menos a ti, qué raro...
The Strong Survive#158.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#159.src: Well, just a word of advice, be careful when picking your friends, it means everything here.
The Strong Survive#159.dst: Bueno, un consejo: ten cuidado al elegir a tus amigos, aquí eso lo es todo.
The Strong Survive#159.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#160.src: If you know the right people, you can climb the ranks quickly. But you must also have to have the abilities to go along with it of course.
The Strong Survive#160.dst: Si conoces a la gente adecuada, subes rápido de rango. Aunque, claro, también hay que tener las aptitudes para acompañarlo.
The Strong Survive#160.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#161.src: You look lost, don't worry, I can help you! Go find Recruiter Effal, he's wearing a yellow headband and is near the center of the room.
The Strong Survive#161.dst: Pareces perdido, ¡tranquilo, yo te ayudo! Busca al reclutador Effal: lleva una cinta amarilla en la cabeza y está cerca del centro de la sala.
The Strong Survive#161.speaker: Recruiter Ollisy

The Strong Survive#163.src: How do you feel about being accepted into the {p} division? I am pretty excited about it, glad Recruiter Olissy noticed my value.
The Strong Survive#163.dst: ¿Qué te parece haber entrado en la división de {p}? Yo estoy muy ilusionada, me alegra que la reclutadora Olissy viera mi valía.
The Strong Survive#163.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#164.src: As someone from Auburn, I'm a bit unsure still, but the recruiters know what they are doing, so I will trust their judgement.
The Strong Survive#164.dst: Como soy de Auburn, todavía no lo tengo muy claro, pero los reclutadores saben lo que hacen, así que me fío de su criterio.
The Strong Survive#164.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#165.src: I don't know much about the {p} either, but I guarantee we will be ready for whatever is in store for us there!
The Strong Survive#165.dst: Yo tampoco sé mucho de {p}, ¡pero te garantizo que estaremos a la altura de lo que nos espere allí!
The Strong Survive#165.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#166.src: I'm not the person you're looking for, go see Recruiter Effal.
The Strong Survive#166.dst: No soy quien buscas, ve a ver al reclutador Effal.
The Strong Survive#166.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#167.src: I have spent nearly my entire life training to become a soldier. I wonder how many other recruits here could say the same.
The Strong Survive#167.dst: Llevo casi toda la vida entrenando para ser soldado. Me pregunto cuántos reclutas de aquí podrían decir lo mismo.
The Strong Survive#167.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#168.src: The Fruman military is in somewhat of a dire state right now, with resistance attacks becoming more brazen than seemingly ever.
The Strong Survive#168.dst: El ejército de Fruma está ahora en una situación bastante grave: los ataques de la resistencia son más descarados que nunca.
The Strong Survive#168.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#169.src: The duty will fall to us to return things back to normalcy. I am up to the task, and I hope you are too.
The Strong Survive#169.dst: A nosotros nos tocará devolver las cosas a la normalidad. Yo estoy a la altura, y espero que tú también.
The Strong Survive#169.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#170.src: Oh hey, you're from the {p}! I'm from Aelumia but I grew up in {p}.
The Strong Survive#170.dst: ¡Anda, eres de {p}! Yo soy de Aelumia, pero crecí en {p}.
The Strong Survive#170.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#171.src: I was assigned to the Wings group though, I'm a bit worried about meeting those expectations...
The Strong Survive#171.dst: Aunque a mí me asignaron al grupo de las Alas, y me preocupa un poco no dar la talla...
The Strong Survive#171.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#172.src: Heh, Oh well, that's what training is for, right?
The Strong Survive#172.dst: Je, bueno, para eso está el entrenamiento, ¿no?
The Strong Survive#172.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#173.src: There you are. Didn't I tell you? Ah, never mind...
The Strong Survive#173.dst: Ahí estás. ¿No te lo dije? Ah, da igual...
The Strong Survive#173.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#174.src: Listen, remember that talk we had with Ferreo, how about that just stays between us ok?
The Strong Survive#174.dst: Oye, esa charla que tuvimos con Ferreo... ¿qué tal si queda entre nosotros?
The Strong Survive#174.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#175.src: I better not see you gossiping to other recruits about it, that would make me very upset!
The Strong Survive#175.dst: ¡Más vale que no te vea cotilleando de eso con otros reclutas, me enfadaría muchísimo!
The Strong Survive#175.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#176.src: The first test for our group is the shield challenge, everyone follow my lead.
The Strong Survive#176.dst: La primera prueba de nuestro grupo es el desafío del escudo. Seguidme todos.
The Strong Survive#176.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#177.src: This area is only for soldiers and injured recruits, and well... You don't look injured.
The Strong Survive#177.dst: Esta zona es solo para soldados y reclutas heridos, y bueno... No pareces herido.
The Strong Survive#177.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#178.src: Sorry recruit, only soldiers are allowed to enter this area.
The Strong Survive#178.dst: Lo siento, recluta, solo los soldados pueden entrar aquí.
The Strong Survive#178.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#179.src: Welcome recruits to the shield challenge.
The Strong Survive#179.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#180.src: Defense is one of the most important aspects of combat. You should not expect yourself to be able to dodge every incoming attack.
The Strong Survive#180.dst: La defensa es uno de los aspectos más importantes del combate. No esperéis poder esquivar todos los ataques que os lleguen.
The Strong Survive#180.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#181.src: A shield can be an incredibly useful tool for a soldier, but holding them up constantly can often interfere with your mobility.
The Strong Survive#181.dst: El escudo puede ser utilísimo para un soldado, pero mantenerlo en alto sin parar suele estorbar vuestra movilidad.
The Strong Survive#181.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#182.src: Knowing when to hold up your shield to defend yourself against incoming arrows or attackers, is thus, a vital skill to learn.
The Strong Survive#182.dst: Por eso, saber cuándo levantar el escudo para protegeros de las flechas o de un atacante es una habilidad vital.
The Strong Survive#182.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#183.src: Your training today will revolve around holding up a shield against arrows that are being fired from turrets.
The Strong Survive#183.dst: El entrenamiento de hoy consistirá en aguantar el escudo en alto contra las flechas que disparan unas torretas.
The Strong Survive#183.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#184.src: The turrets will give an indication of when they are about to fire, however, the shields provided to you have many weights embedded into them.
The Strong Survive#184.dst: Las torretas avisan antes de disparar; ahora bien, los escudos que se os dan llevan muchos pesos incrustados.
The Strong Survive#184.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#185.src: Most of you will only be able to hold your shield up for a second or two at a time, so you must do so wisely.
The Strong Survive#185.dst: La mayoría solo podréis mantener el escudo en alto uno o dos segundos seguidos, así que hacedlo con cabeza.
The Strong Survive#185.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#186.src: I have set up a turret here that you can use to practice getting used to handling the weighted shield.
The Strong Survive#186.dst: He instalado aquí una torreta para que os acostumbréis a manejar el escudo lastrado.
The Strong Survive#186.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#187.src: Simply stand where I am now, then click the button behind me. Face the turret and hold up your shield when, or just before, it fires an arrow.
The Strong Survive#187.dst: Poneos donde estoy yo y pulsad el botón de detrás. Encarad la torreta y levantad el escudo cuando dispare, o justo antes.
The Strong Survive#187.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#188.src: Good luck recruits, I will be judging you from an overlook point. If you haven't already, take a shield from the shield rack next to Recruiter Effal.
The Strong Survive#188.dst: Suerte, reclutas, os juzgaré desde el mirador. Quien no lo tenga, que coja un escudo del soporte junto al reclutador Effal.
The Strong Survive#188.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#189.src: When you're ready to start the challenge, enter the large door behind me.
The Strong Survive#189.dst: Cuando estéis listos para empezar, entrad por la puerta grande de detrás de mí.
The Strong Survive#189.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#190.src: Enter the next room and complete the challenge.
The Strong Survive#190.dst: Entra en la siguiente sala y completa el desafío.

The Strong Survive#191.src: Stop lingering around. The sooner you get this challenge done, the sooner I get to have lunch.
The Strong Survive#191.dst: Deja de dar vueltas. Cuanto antes acabéis este desafío, antes podré comer.
The Strong Survive#191.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#192.src: That's it, holding up a shield against turrets? What a bore.
The Strong Survive#192.dst: ¿Ya está? ¿Aguantar un escudo contra torretas? Qué aburrimiento.
The Strong Survive#192.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#193.src: It seems like the instructors are basing these challenges off of the idea that we haven't done any training beforehand.
The Strong Survive#193.dst: Parece que los instructores plantean estos desafíos dando por hecho que no hemos entrenado nunca.
The Strong Survive#193.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#194.src: They are wasting our time. Anyone who would struggle in a challenge like this has no hope of amounting to anything.
The Strong Survive#194.dst: Nos hacen perder el tiempo. Quien tenga problemas con algo así no llegará nunca a nada.
The Strong Survive#194.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#195.src: These shields are really heavy, it feels like I can only hold them up for around half a second...
The Strong Survive#195.dst: Estos escudos pesan muchísimo, siento que solo puedo mantenerlo en alto medio segundo...
The Strong Survive#195.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#196.src: There's no point in overthinking this, I'm sure we'll both do well!
The Strong Survive#196.dst: No tiene sentido darle vueltas, ¡seguro que a los dos nos va bien!
The Strong Survive#196.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#197.src: Don't worry {u}, this one is the easiest of the three challenges.
The Strong Survive#197.dst: Tranquilo, {u}, este es el más fácil de los tres desafíos.
The Strong Survive#197.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#198.src: Or was it the endurance challenge that was the easiest? Hmmm, I forget.
The Strong Survive#198.dst: ¿O era el desafío de resistencia el más fácil? Hmmm, no me acuerdo.
The Strong Survive#198.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#199.src: It's your turn {u}, stand on that plate to start the test.
The Strong Survive#199.dst: Te toca, {u}, súbete a esa placa para empezar la prueba.
The Strong Survive#199.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#200.src: Well done, now exit through the door across from you.
The Strong Survive#200.dst: Bien hecho, ahora sal por la puerta de enfrente.
The Strong Survive#200.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#201.src: Head to the second challenge room after you speak to Arnol.
The Strong Survive#201.dst: Ve a la segunda sala de desafíos después de hablar con Arnol.

The Strong Survive#202.src: You've really made a habit of testing my patience...
The Strong Survive#202.dst: Se te está haciendo costumbre poner a prueba mi paciencia...
The Strong Survive#202.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#203.src: Your performance better make up for it. Now, follow me to the next challenge.
The Strong Survive#203.dst: Más vale que tu rendimiento lo compense. Ahora, sígueme al siguiente desafío.
The Strong Survive#203.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#204.src: Hey {u}, I am ashamed to say it, but things didn't go well for me...
The Strong Survive#204.dst: Oye, {u}, me da vergüenza decirlo, pero a mí no me ha ido bien...
The Strong Survive#204.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#205.src: I wasn't able to complete the challenge...
The Strong Survive#205.dst: No he sido capaz de completar el desafío...
The Strong Survive#205.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#206.src: I couldn't even manage to raise the shield up to block a single arrow! After a while, the instructor just told me to move on.
The Strong Survive#206.dst: ¡No conseguí levantar el escudo ni para parar una sola flecha! Al rato, el instructor me dijo que pasara.
The Strong Survive#206.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#207.src: I should have seen this coming... What about you, how did things go for you?
The Strong Survive#207.dst: Debería haberlo visto venir... ¿Y tú, cómo te ha ido?
The Strong Survive#207.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#208.src: Good job ! I am glad that one of us was able to do well. I'd like to learn about how you did it later.
The Strong Survive#208.dst: ¡Buen trabajo! Me alegro de que al menos a uno de los dos le haya salido bien. Luego me cuentas cómo lo hiciste.
The Strong Survive#208.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#209.src: Good job ! I am glad that you managed to finish. We should talk more about it later.
The Strong Survive#209.dst: ¡Buen trabajo! Me alegro de que hayas conseguido terminar. Deberíamos hablarlo más luego.
The Strong Survive#209.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#210.src: Well, maybe you just had more strength training than me. The shield was just too heavy to hold up, I don't know what else to say.
The Strong Survive#210.dst: Bueno, quizá tú tienes más entrenamiento de fuerza que yo. El escudo pesaba demasiado, no sé qué más decir.
The Strong Survive#210.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#211.src: We should go to our next challenge now, let's hope Effal doesn't erupt at us for being late.
The Strong Survive#211.dst: Deberíamos ir ya al siguiente desafío, esperemos que Effal no estalle por llegar tarde.
The Strong Survive#211.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#212.src: Listen to the challenge instructions then enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
The Strong Survive#212.dst: Escucha las instrucciones del desafío, entra en la siguiente sala y completa el segundo desafío.

The Strong Survive#213.src: Now that everyone's here, we may finally begin.
The Strong Survive#213.dst: Ahora que estamos todos, por fin podemos empezar.
The Strong Survive#213.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#214.src: As a soldier, you will be defined by your endurance, it is your will to carry on through the fight!
The Strong Survive#214.dst: Como soldados, os definirá vuestra resistencia: ¡es la voluntad de seguir peleando!
The Strong Survive#214.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#215.src: The terrain you battle on will never be optimal, so you must be able to adapt to it to ensure your success.
The Strong Survive#215.dst: El terreno en el que luchéis nunca será el ideal, así que debéis saber adaptaros para tener éxito.
The Strong Survive#215.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#216.src: As part of this training exercise, you will be jumping from platforms until you reach the end of an endurance course.
The Strong Survive#216.dst: En este ejercicio saltaréis de plataforma en plataforma hasta llegar al final de un circuito de resistencia.
The Strong Survive#216.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#217.src: If you fall, you will have to go back to the start and continue from there.
The Strong Survive#217.dst: Si os caéis, tendréis que volver al inicio y seguir desde allí.
The Strong Survive#217.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#218.src: We have installed jump pads on the platforms to help ease you into making riskier leaps.
The Strong Survive#218.dst: Hemos puesto trampolines en las plataformas para facilitaros los saltos más arriesgados.
The Strong Survive#218.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#219.src: To use the jump pads, simply stand on them and jump. The mechanism will detect the sudden weight loss and boost you.
The Strong Survive#219.dst: Para usarlos, basta con poneros encima y saltar. El mecanismo notará la pérdida súbita de peso y os impulsará.
The Strong Survive#219.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#220.src: I've installed a jump pad in this room to the right of me if any of you want to practice before starting the course.
The Strong Survive#220.dst: He puesto un trampolín en esta sala, a mi derecha, por si alguno quiere practicar antes del circuito.
The Strong Survive#220.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#221.src: Soon you'll all hopefully be able to complete a course similar to this one but without the crutch.
The Strong Survive#221.dst: Espero que pronto podáis completar un circuito parecido, pero sin esa muleta.
The Strong Survive#221.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#222.src: You may enter the large door behind me to begin. Oh, and your performance will be judged on how quickly you reach the exit.
The Strong Survive#222.dst: Podéis entrar por la puerta grande de detrás de mí. Ah, y se os juzgará por lo rápido que lleguéis a la salida.
The Strong Survive#222.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#223.src: I'm going to take my time on the jumps. After what happened in the first challenge, there's no point in rushing through.
The Strong Survive#223.dst: Voy a tomármelo con calma en los saltos. Después de lo del primer desafío, no tiene sentido ir con prisas.
The Strong Survive#223.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#224.src: Alright, I think I'm ready, let's sit together in the cafeteria after this.
The Strong Survive#224.dst: Vale, creo que estoy listo; luego sentémonos juntos en el comedor.
The Strong Survive#224.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#225.src: Yeah, it was this one that was the easiest challenge for me!
The Strong Survive#225.dst: ¡Sí, este fue para mí el desafío más fácil!
The Strong Survive#225.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#226.src: Just get through the platforms as quickly as you can and you'll be fine.
The Strong Survive#226.dst: Pasa las plataformas lo más rápido que puedas y estarás bien.
The Strong Survive#226.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#227.src: What is it, do you want advice?
The Strong Survive#227.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#228.src: Well, I can recommend that you go quickly, but you must also be aware of your surroundings.
The Strong Survive#228.dst: Bueno, te recomiendo ir rápido, pero también estar atento a lo que te rodea.
The Strong Survive#228.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#229.src: The rest is up to you, think carefully about how you want to approach this.
The Strong Survive#229.dst: El resto depende de ti; piensa bien cómo quieres afrontarlo.
The Strong Survive#229.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#230.src: I am surprised by the amount of recruits who rush head first into these challenges.
The Strong Survive#230.dst: Me sorprende la cantidad de reclutas que se lanzan de cabeza a estos desafíos.
The Strong Survive#230.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#231.src: Why not think about your approach beforehand? They are all setting themselves up for failure.
The Strong Survive#231.dst: ¿Por qué no pensar antes en cómo abordarlo? Todos se están buscando el fracaso.
The Strong Survive#231.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#233.src: Find the cafeteria and sit next to Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#233.dst: Encuentra el comedor y siéntate junto a Arnol en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#234.src: Not a bad time, of course, not as good as mine, but it's fine since you're still learning.
The Strong Survive#234.dst: No es mal tiempo; peor que el mío, claro, pero vale, aún estás aprendiendo.
The Strong Survive#234.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#235.src: Wow, you really took your time in there, don't worry, you'll get better... You, will get better? Right?
The Strong Survive#235.dst: Vaya, sí que te lo has tomado con calma ahí dentro. Tranquilo, mejorarás... Vas a mejorar, ¿verdad?
The Strong Survive#235.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#236.src: It's time to head to the cafeteria for lunch with the other recruits. Follow me, I'll show you where it is.
The Strong Survive#236.dst: Toca ir al comedor a comer con los demás reclutas. Sígueme, te enseño dónde está.
The Strong Survive#236.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#237.src: Go through that corridor and then enter into the room on the right. Try not to eat too much, alright?
The Strong Survive#237.dst: Cruza ese pasillo y entra en la sala de la derecha. Intenta no comer demasiado, ¿vale?
The Strong Survive#237.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#238.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#238.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#239.src: It's lunch time recruit, your food and the other recruits are in the cafeteria. It's the room to the left as soon as you enter the next room.
The Strong Survive#239.dst: Es la hora de comer, recluta; tu comida y los demás reclutas están en el comedor. Es la sala de la izquierda nada más entrar en la siguiente.
The Strong Survive#239.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#240.src: Enjoy your meal, you deserve it!
The Strong Survive#240.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#241.src: There you are {u}, come sit next to me so we can talk about the second challenge.
The Strong Survive#241.dst: Ahí estás, {u}, ven a sentarte a mi lado y hablamos del segundo desafío.
The Strong Survive#241.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#242.src: The chef did a great job with these meals. They must be from Aelumia!
The Strong Survive#242.dst: El cocinero se ha lucido con esta comida. ¡Seguro que es de Aelumia!
The Strong Survive#242.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#243.src: It's a shame that the lesser recruits also get to have it. I would have had them eating from a trough with the horses!
The Strong Survive#243.dst: Es una pena que los reclutas de segunda también la tengan. ¡Yo los habría hecho comer del pesebre con los caballos!
The Strong Survive#243.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#244.src: I certainly don't look forward to having to sleep in the same room as the Auburn recruits...
The Strong Survive#244.dst: Desde luego, no me hace ninguna gracia tener que dormir en la misma sala que los reclutas de Auburn...
The Strong Survive#244.speaker: Katze

The Strong Survive#245.src: I can't stop thinking about Sovereign Majin's speech, it was just... Perfect!
The Strong Survive#245.dst: No dejo de pensar en el discurso del Soberano Majin, fue... ¡Perfecto!
The Strong Survive#245.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#246.src: We must remember those words, especially the part about the importance of proving ourselves.
The Strong Survive#246.dst: Debemos recordar esas palabras, sobre todo la parte de lo importante que es demostrar nuestra valía.
The Strong Survive#246.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#247.src: So, the challenges, how did they go for you?
The Strong Survive#247.dst: Bueno, los desafíos, ¿qué tal os han ido?
The Strong Survive#247.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#248.src: Well! Things went well! They were a bit difficult but I managed.
The Strong Survive#248.dst: ¡Bien! ¡Me ha ido bien! Eran algo difíciles, pero me las apañé.
The Strong Survive#248.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#249.src: That's good to hear, we want to make sure everyone in our circle does well on them, so try to keep it that way.
The Strong Survive#249.dst: Me alegra oírlo; queremos que a todos los de nuestro círculo les vaya bien, así que sigue así.
The Strong Survive#249.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#251.src: I hope our training gets tougher, I'd hardly call them challenges given their current difficulty.
The Strong Survive#251.dst: Ojalá el entrenamiento se endurezca; con esta dificultad, difícilmente los llamaría desafíos.
The Strong Survive#251.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#252.src: We were accepted into the {p} division, it makes sense that these challenges are easier for us.
The Strong Survive#252.dst: Nos aceptaron en la división de {p}, tiene sentido que estos desafíos nos resulten más fáciles.
The Strong Survive#252.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#253.src: Yeah, you're right, Recruiter Olissy told me herself that she sees great potential in us. We should try our best to live up to her expectations, and the expectations set for us as future {p} soldiers as well!
The Strong Survive#253.dst: Sí, tienes razón, la propia reclutadora Olissy me dijo que ve un gran potencial en nosotras. Deberíamos esforzarnos por estar a la altura de sus expectativas, ¡y de las que se esperan de nosotras como futuras soldados de {p}!
The Strong Survive#253.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#254.src: I have been watching many of the recruits, seeing how they act and communicate with each other, and frankly, it worries me.
The Strong Survive#254.dst: He estado observando a muchos reclutas, cómo se comportan y cómo se tratan entre ellos y, francamente, me preocupa.
The Strong Survive#254.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#255.src: Many of them are treating {p} like some sort of children's school, they do not seem to understand what awaits them.
The Strong Survive#255.dst: Muchos tratan {p} como si fuera una escuela infantil; no parecen entender lo que les espera.
The Strong Survive#255.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#256.src: Of course, it is still only the first day, so hopefully this behaviour does not persist.
The Strong Survive#256.dst: Claro que solo es el primer día, así que espero que esta actitud no se mantenga.
The Strong Survive#256.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#257.src: And if it does. I trust that Commander Ferreo will deal with it.
The Strong Survive#257.dst: Y si se mantiene, confío en que el comandante Ferreo lo resuelva.
The Strong Survive#257.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#258.src: Commander Ferreo has been working for the Fruman military for a long time, we're lucky to be training under him.
The Strong Survive#258.dst: El comandante Ferreo lleva mucho tiempo en el ejército de Fruma; tenemos suerte de entrenar a sus órdenes.
The Strong Survive#258.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#259.src: I hear he was offered a blessing early on in his service, back when he was still in the {p} division. He was very famous back then, everyone in {p} and Aelumia knew him!
The Strong Survive#259.dst: He oído que le ofrecieron una bendición al principio de su servicio, cuando aún estaba en la división de {p}. ¡Entonces era famosísimo, todos en {p} y en Aelumia lo conocían!
The Strong Survive#259.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#260.src: I hope I can accomplish ending up as half the soldier he was!
The Strong Survive#260.dst: ¡Ojalá llegue a ser la mitad de soldado de lo que él fue!
The Strong Survive#260.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#261.src: None of my friends ended up being chose to become a recruit like I was, I feel like a complete stranger here.
The Strong Survive#261.dst: A ninguno de mis amigos lo eligieron como recluta, solo a mí; aquí me siento completamente extraña.
The Strong Survive#261.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#262.src: But that's fine, we aren't here to socialize, we are here to prove ourselves worthy of the title of soldier!
The Strong Survive#262.dst: Pero está bien, no venimos a socializar, ¡venimos a demostrar que merecemos el título de soldado!
The Strong Survive#262.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#263.src: I didn't do too well on the first two challenges, I hope I can make up for it on my last one.
The Strong Survive#263.dst: No me fue muy bien en los dos primeros desafíos, espero compensarlo en el último.
The Strong Survive#263.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#264.src: Really Holger? You get access to a giant buffet and all you get is a salad and a small fish?
The Strong Survive#264.dst: ¿En serio, Holger? Tienes delante un bufé enorme, ¿y solo coges una ensalada y un pescadito?
The Strong Survive#264.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#265.src: You idiot, not everyone needs to stuff their face with food like you! This is why mom says I'm the smarter one.
The Strong Survive#265.dst: Idiota, ¡no todo el mundo tiene que atiborrarse como tú! Por eso mamá dice que la lista soy yo.
The Strong Survive#265.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#266.src: Well who does she say the stronger one is? That's what really matters!
The Strong Survive#266.dst: ¿Y a quién dice que es el fuerte? ¡Eso es lo que importa!
The Strong Survive#266.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#267.src: Can you two go five minutes without arguing with each other?
The Strong Survive#267.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#268.src: It's nice to finally eat something. I skipped breakfast today, I was too worried that I'd end up hurling it back up.
The Strong Survive#268.dst: Qué bien comer algo por fin. Hoy me salté el desayuno; tenía demasiado miedo de acabar echándolo todo.
The Strong Survive#268.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#269.src: Anyways, about the endurance training. It took some time, but I figured out the perfect strategy to get through the course!
The Strong Survive#269.dst: En fin, sobre el entrenamiento de resistencia. Me costó un rato, ¡pero di con la estrategia perfecta para el circuito!
The Strong Survive#269.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#270.src: I definitely am better at agility tests, I wonder if the instructors will take that into account when grading us.
The Strong Survive#270.dst: Sin duda se me dan mejor las pruebas de agilidad; no sé si los instructores lo tendrán en cuenta al puntuarnos.
The Strong Survive#270.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#271.src: How about you, did you struggle with the jumps, or finish the course quickly?
The Strong Survive#271.dst: ¿Y tú? ¿Te costaron los saltos o acabaste el circuito rápido?
The Strong Survive#271.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#273.src: It sure was tricky, but at least-
The Strong Survive#273.dst: Sí que era complicado, pero al menos-
The Strong Survive#273.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#274.src: Oh... Well, I guess you don't-
The Strong Survive#274.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#275.src: You are Arnol, yes? You must come with me.
The Strong Survive#275.dst: Eres Arnol, ¿verdad? Tienes que venir conmigo.
The Strong Survive#275.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#276.src: I am in the middle of eating, can't I go after I finish my meal?
The Strong Survive#276.dst: Estoy comiendo, ¿no puedo ir cuando termine?
The Strong Survive#276.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#278.src: You're not sitting with anyone? You're a strange one, {u}.
The Strong Survive#278.dst: ¿No te sientas con nadie? Eres raro, {u}.
The Strong Survive#278.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#279.src: The last challenge of the day will be dueling, the other {p} recruits are already heading there, follow me.
The Strong Survive#279.dst: El último desafío del día son los duelos; los demás reclutas de {p} ya van para allá, sígueme.
The Strong Survive#279.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#280.src: What was that about, where do you think that guy took Katze?
The Strong Survive#280.dst: ¿Qué ha sido eso? ¿Adónde crees que se ha llevado a Katze?
The Strong Survive#280.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#281.src: No clue, but it seems like that Arnol kid was also asked to go with them.
The Strong Survive#281.dst: Ni idea, pero parece que al chaval ese, Arnol, también le han pedido que fuera.
The Strong Survive#281.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#282.src: Whatever it is, it doesn't seem good...
The Strong Survive#282.dst: Sea lo que sea, no pinta bien...
The Strong Survive#282.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#283.src: Go to the challenge room and receive instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#283.dst: Ve a la sala de desafíos y recibe las instrucciones del último desafío del día en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#284.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#284.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#285.src: If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
The Strong Survive#285.dst: Si ya has terminado de comer, espera en el comedor a que el reclutador Effal te lleve al siguiente desafío.
The Strong Survive#285.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#286.src: And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#286.dst: Y si el reclutador Effal ya ha venido a por tu grupo, entonces... deberías estar con él en la sala de duelos.
The Strong Survive#286.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#287.src: Your final challenge today will be singular combat against another recruit.
The Strong Survive#287.dst: Vuestro último desafío de hoy será un combate singular contra otro recluta.
The Strong Survive#287.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#288.src: When up against the enemy, you may find yourself in a similar situation. You must be prepared for when this happens.
The Strong Survive#288.dst: Frente al enemigo podéis veros en una situación parecida. Debéis estar preparados para cuando ocurra.
The Strong Survive#288.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#289.src: This test serves as a way to further gauge your skills, as well as an opportunity to show off the strategies you have developed in melee.
The Strong Survive#289.dst: Esta prueba sirve para medir mejor vuestras aptitudes y también para mostrar las estrategias que habéis desarrollado en el cuerpo a cuerpo.
The Strong Survive#289.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#290.src: The most important skill to have in a duel is patience, to know when you have an opening to attack. But of course, agility and strength are also deciding factors.
The Strong Survive#290.dst: Lo más importante en un duelo es la paciencia: saber cuándo tenéis un hueco para atacar. Aunque, claro, la agilidad y la fuerza también son decisivas.
The Strong Survive#290.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#291.src: Use your agility to avoid attacks, but if you find yourself unable to dodge, you must stand on guard and block incoming attacks.
The Strong Survive#291.dst: Usad vuestra agilidad para esquivar, pero si no podéis hacerlo, poneos en guardia y bloquead los ataques.
The Strong Survive#291.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#292.src: Blocking precisely as your opponent strikes may catch them off guard, allowing you an opportunity to retaliate.
The Strong Survive#292.dst: Bloquear justo cuando golpea el rival puede pillarlo desprevenido y daros ocasión de responder.
The Strong Survive#292.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#293.src: You weapon is a wooden training estoc. The edges are dulled, so you will not need to hold back your strength.
The Strong Survive#293.dst: Vuestra arma es un estoque de entrenamiento de madera. Los filos están romos, así que no hace falta contenerse.
The Strong Survive#293.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#294.src: Your performance will be judged by me, if I see one side clearly winning over the other I will declare a victor.
The Strong Survive#294.dst: Yo juzgaré vuestro desempeño; si veo que un lado gana con claridad, declararé vencedor.
The Strong Survive#294.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#295.src: Make sure to get yourself an estoc before entering the challenge room, I will oversee the challenges shortly, so do not start until I get there.
The Strong Survive#295.dst: Coged un estoque antes de entrar en la sala de desafíos. Iré enseguida a supervisar, así que no empecéis hasta que llegue.
The Strong Survive#295.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#296.src: Complete the final challenge of the day.
The Strong Survive#296.dst: Completa el último desafío del día.

The Strong Survive#297.src: It seems like the commander wants to see you, just look at how he's staring at you...
The Strong Survive#297.dst: Parece que el comandante quiere verte, mira cómo te está mirando...
The Strong Survive#297.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#298.src: Well whatever it's about, try not to make me look bad, ok?
The Strong Survive#298.dst: Bueno, sea lo que sea, intenta no dejarme en mal lugar, ¿vale?
The Strong Survive#298.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#299.src: I hope your talk with Ferreo went well.
The Strong Survive#299.dst: Espero que fuera bien con Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#299.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#300.src: I'll just assume things went well, based on the fact that you're still in this room.
The Strong Survive#300.dst: Daré por hecho que fue bien, visto que sigues en esta sala.
The Strong Survive#300.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#301.src: Sorry recruit, there's not much advice I can give you here, I wasn't that good at this challenge during my training.
The Strong Survive#301.dst: Lo siento, recluta, aquí no puedo darte muchos consejos: a mí este desafío no se me daba nada bien.
The Strong Survive#301.speaker: Recruiter Ollisy

The Strong Survive#302.src: I just could never bring myself to go all out on a fellow recruit, what if I accidentally hurt them?
The Strong Survive#302.dst: Nunca fui capaz de emplearme a fondo contra otro recluta, ¿y si lo hería sin querer?
The Strong Survive#302.speaker: Recruiter Ollisy

The Strong Survive#303.src: Ah, here's some advice! Don't do what I did, and you'll do fine!
The Strong Survive#303.dst: ¡Ah, ahí va un consejo! ¡No hagas lo que hice yo y te irá bien!
The Strong Survive#303.speaker: Recruiter Ollisy

The Strong Survive#304.src: Dueling against other recruits seems strange to me... Won't we be working together when we become soldiers?
The Strong Survive#304.dst: Batirnos contra otros reclutas me parece extraño... ¿No vamos a trabajar juntos cuando seamos soldados?
The Strong Survive#304.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#305.src: It's fine, I don't want to question Commander Ferreo. He's dedicated his life to protecting others, I trust his opinion more than mine.
The Strong Survive#305.dst: Da igual, no quiero cuestionar al comandante Ferreo. Ha dedicado su vida a proteger a los demás, me fío más de su criterio que del mío.
The Strong Survive#305.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#306.src: So, it looks like your buddy Arnol quit early, what else is new?
The Strong Survive#306.dst: Vaya, parece que tu amiguito Arnol lo ha dejado pronto, ¿qué novedad?
The Strong Survive#306.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#307.src: From the moment I saw him here, I knew he wouldn't be able to last a day.
The Strong Survive#307.dst: Desde que lo vi aquí, supe que no aguantaría ni un día.
The Strong Survive#307.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#308.src: But, if it turns out that he didn't leave, I wouldn't stick with him, if I were you.
The Strong Survive#308.dst: Pero, si resulta que no se ha ido, yo que tú no me quedaría a su lado.
The Strong Survive#308.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#309.src: You don't want his weakness to rub off on you.
The Strong Survive#309.dst: No querrás que se te pegue su debilidad.
The Strong Survive#309.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#310.src: I would like a word with you first.
The Strong Survive#310.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#311.src: I've been looking forward to speaking with you, one on one.
The Strong Survive#311.dst: Tenía ganas de hablar contigo a solas.
The Strong Survive#311.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#312.src: I want you to remember that the only reason you're here is because I allowed you to be here, and because I see some potential in you.
The Strong Survive#312.dst: Quiero que recuerdes que estás aquí solo porque yo lo he permitido y porque veo cierto potencial en ti.
The Strong Survive#312.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#313.src: If you are unable to realize this potential fully, or become more trouble than you're worth, I won't hesitate to have you kicked out.
The Strong Survive#313.dst: Si no eres capaz de desarrollarlo del todo, o das más problemas de lo que vales, no dudaré en echarte.
The Strong Survive#313.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#314.src: So, for your sake, I hope you do well on these challenges.
The Strong Survive#314.dst: Así que, por tu bien, espero que te vaya bien en estos desafíos.
The Strong Survive#314.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#315.src: Step up, and the duel may begin.
The Strong Survive#315.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#318.src: Now, both of you, exit the room and take a look at your final rankings of the day.
The Strong Survive#318.dst: Ahora salid los dos y mirad la clasificación final del día.
The Strong Survive#318.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#319.src: Leave the challenge room and check your ranking, then talk to Arnol.
The Strong Survive#319.dst: Sal de la sala de desafíos, mira tu clasificación y habla con Arnol.

The Strong Survive#320.src: That was the last training exercise for the day.
The Strong Survive#320.dst: Ese ha sido el último ejercicio del día.
The Strong Survive#320.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#321.src: Your ranking can be found on the board over there. Be sure to take a look, I hope it can serve as motivation.
The Strong Survive#321.dst: Vuestra clasificación está en ese tablón. Miradla, espero que os sirva de motivación.
The Strong Survive#321.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#322.src: Once you're done here, head up to the recruit barracks and rest for the night.
The Strong Survive#322.dst: Cuando acabéis aquí, subid al barracón de reclutas y descansad.
The Strong Survive#322.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#323.src: The barracks are up those stairs in the room directly across from the staircase.
The Strong Survive#323.dst: El barracón está subiendo esas escaleras, en la sala justo enfrente.
The Strong Survive#323.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#324.src: What a day huh? I hope you ended up with a ranking that you're proud of.
